content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant the premises located at 123 Main Street, Springfield City, State of Novacorp.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term
content_blocks.text: The term of this Lease shall commence on July 1, 2024, and end on June 30, 2029.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rent
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $3,500 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month.
